import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Mint {
        long value;

        public Mint(long value) {
            this.value = value % md;
        }

        public static Mint inverse(Mint a) {
            long u = 0, v = 1;
            while (a.value != 0) {
                long t = md / a.value;
                md -= t * a.value;
                a.value = md;
                u -= t * v;
                u %= md;
                swap(u, v);
            }
            assert (md == 1);
            return new Mint(u);
        }

        public Mint add(Mint other) {
            return new Mint((value + other.value) % md);
        }

        public Mint subtract(Mint other) {
            return new Mint((value - other.value + md) % md);
        }

        public Mint multiply(Mint other) {
            return new Mint((value * other.value) % md);
        }

        public Mint divide(Mint other) {
            return multiply(inverse(other));
        }

        public static Mint power(Mint a, long b) {
            assert (b >= 0);
            Mint x = a, res = new Mint(1);
            long p = b;
            while (p > 0) {
                if (p % 2 == 1) res = res.multiply(x);
                x = x.multiply(x);
                p /= 2;
            }
            return res;
        }

        public String toString() {
            return Long.toString(value);
        }
    }

    static class Combination {
        public static Mint C(int n, int k) {
            Mint res = new Mint(1);
            for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
                res = res.multiply(new Mint(n - i + 1));
                res = res.divide(new Mint(i));
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int md = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        Mint[] fact = new Mint[m + 1];
        fact[0] = new Mint(1);
        Mint[] inv_fact = new Mint[m + 1];
        inv_fact[0] = new Mint(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            fact[i] = fact[i - 1].multiply(new Mint(i));
            inv_fact[i] = inv_fact[i - 1].multiply(Mint.inverse(new Mint(i)));
        }
        Mint[] ptr_dp = new Mint[m + 1];
        Mint[] ptr_ways = new Mint[m + 1];
        ptr_ways[0] = new Mint(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int l = j, r = i - 1 - l;
                ptr_ways[i] = ptr_ways[i].add(ptr_ways[l].multiply(ptr_ways[r]).multiply(Combination.C(l + r, l).multiply(new Mint(l + r + 2))));
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int l = j, r = i - 1 - l;
                Mint add = (new Mint(l).multiply(new Mint(l + 1)).add(new Mint(r).multiply(new Mint(r + 1)))).divide(new Mint(2));
                ptr_dp[i] = ptr_dp[i].add(ptr_ways[l].multiply(ptr_ways[r]).multiply(Combination.C(l + r, l).multiply(add)));
                ptr_dp[i] = ptr_dp[i].add((ptr_dp[l].multiply(ptr_ways[r]).add(ptr_dp[r].multiply(ptr_ways[l]))).multiply(Combination.C(l + r, r).multiply(new Mint(l + r + 2))));
            }
        }
        Mint[][] dp = new Mint[n + 1][m + 1];
        Mint[][] ways = new Mint[n + 1][m + 1];
        ways[0][0] = new Mint(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= Math.min(m, i); s++) {
                if (s == i) {
                    dp[i][s] = ptr_dp[s];
                    ways[i][s] = ptr_ways[s];
                    continue;
                }
                for (int d = 1; d <= s + 1; d++) {
                    Mint ft = dp[i - d][s + 1 - d];
                    Mint way = ways[i - d][s + 1 - d];
                    int add = d - 1;
                    ways[i][s] = ways[i][s].add(way.multiply(ptr_ways[add]).multiply(Combination.C(s, add)));
                    dp[i][s] = dp[i][s].add((way.multiply(ptr_dp[add]).add(ptr_ways[add].multiply(ft))).multiply(Combination.C(s, add)));
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(dp[n][m].value);
    }

    static void swap(long a, long b) {
        long temp = a;
        a = b;
        b = temp;
    }
}
